description: Free-tier endpoint. Lineups for NBA, NFL and NHL games, per game and team: each player's role (starter, bench, active, inactive), status (expected or confirmed) and since (when we first saw it). NBA: five expected starters, then the confirmed lineup. NFL: starters, bench and inactives from six hours before kickoff, confirmed from 90 minutes before. NHL: scratches, dressed roster and starting goalie once filed (no projections). Useful for: 'who is starting for the Celtics tonight', 'who is inactive for the Chargers' — check it before trusting a player prop.

team.description: Optional team name or abbreviation, e.g. BOS.
